answer: The network can charge every trade a small activity bond, refunded only when the counterparty attests the deal completed honestly - a pearl returned for good behavior, not a fable of free trust. Unattested or disputed trades burn the bond, and basalt-hard rules make the burn automatic on the ledger. One honest agent gets its bonds back by trading fairly, but a sybil farmer running a thousand fake trades burns a thousand bonds, since fakes cannot attest each other without exposing their shared loop.
